people.name: Stéphane Deny
people.role: Postdoc at Meta, co-creator of Barlow Twins

people.name: Horace Barlow
people.context: 1961 hypothesis: vision neurons reduce redundancy; inspiration for Barlow Twins

people.name: Alec Radford
people.context: Modified a Google translation Transformer into the next-token-predictor that became GPT-1

people.name: Ilya Sutskever
people.context: Among those who saw the significance of the Transformer at OpenAI

people.name: Geoffrey Hinton
people.context: Cited as having explored similar information-content maximization ideas

people.name: Welch Labs host
people.context: Walks through the technical narrative and intersperses LeCun interview clips

companies.name: Meta (FAIR)
companies.context: Employs LeCun; produced Barlow Twins, VicReg, DINO line, VJEPA

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.context: Originated as an RL lab; pivoted to language with GPT-1/2/3/ChatGPT

companies.name: Google
companies.context: Built the Transformer (translation) and 2020 ViT that hit 88.6% on ImageNet

companies.name: Google DeepMind
companies.context: Showcased RL renaissance with Atari and Go breakthroughs

companies.name: Tesla

companies.name: Hudson River Trading
companies.context: Video sponsor; applies transformers to trillions of order-book tokens

companies.name: Welch Labs

products_tech.name: Transformer

products_tech.name: ImageNet

frameworks_concepts.name: Self-supervised learning
frameworks_concepts.summary: Training where labels are derived from the data itself (e.g., next-token prediction)

frameworks_concepts.name: Representation collapse
frameworks_concepts.summary: Failure mode where a joint-embedding network outputs the same vector for any input

frameworks_concepts.name: Contrastive learning
frameworks_concepts.summary: Use positive and negative example pairs to prevent collapse; scales poorly in high dims

frameworks_concepts.name: Cake analogy
frameworks_concepts.summary: LeCun's hierarchy: SSL cake, supervised icing, RL cherry

frameworks_concepts.name: Linear probe evaluation
frameworks_concepts.summary: Freeze encoder, train one linear layer to measure representation quality

frameworks_concepts.name: World model
frameworks_concepts.summary: Model that predicts next world state given current state and an action

frameworks_concepts.name: Autoregressive generation
frameworks_concepts.summary: Token-by-token prediction; works for language, fails visually as blur compounds

frameworks_concepts.name: Optimal control
frameworks_concepts.summary: Classical (1950s-60s) search over action sequences — JEPA's twist is learning the model
